Modeled to your level of information need

Following ISO 19650 and EN 17412, we define what each model needs: geometry, information and documentation, per stage. No more, no less.

StageGeometryInformationDocumentation
DesignSystems with accurate sizes and routesSystem types, flows and design dataDesign drawings and calculations
CoordinationSupports, clearances and interfaces with structureZones, levels and clash statusClash reports and coordination drawings
ConstructionCoreManufacturer families, fittings and real dimensionsApproved product data from submittalsShop drawings and quantities
As-builtCoreField-verified model of what was installedSerials, warranties and install datesAs-built drawings
OperationSimplified model for FMAsset register and maintenance dataCOBie and Excel export

An asset register built into the model

Every chiller, pump, AHU and valve carries the data facility managers need, so handover is a file, not a filing cabinet.

  • Asset IDs, locations and system names
  • Manufacturer, model, serial and warranty data
  • Maintenance info exported to Excel or COBie

How we work

Remote delivery through ACC or your own data environment, with a check-in at every step.

  1. Brief & scope

    Send drawings and standards. Get a fixed quote and schedule.

  2. Design review

    We flag design gaps before modeling.

  3. Model

    MEP model to the agreed LOIN, in your template.

  4. Coordinate

    Clashes resolved and signed off by each trade.

  5. Issue

    Shop drawings, model and reports delivered.

Why BIM Nexus

BIM Nexus is an independent engineering studio for MEP. We combine design knowledge, technical office practice and BIM, so models are buildable and data is usable.

You work directly with the engineer doing the work, with clear scope, fixed quotes and native files at every stage.
